# Set-up

## Set options & import sources

```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

library(ragg)
library(here)
```
